title: Statement of contracts made by the Ordnance Department, year ending December 31, 1845
lineage: Research notes paraphrase the specified source passages; the notes are not a reproduction.

passages.note: Government table records a contract dated 18 February 1845 for 10,000 rifles at $11.90 each, five years, for Robbins, Kendall & Lawrence. Springfield is listed as place of manufacture or delivery, not necessarily factory location.
